mistakes: `<base.button disabled={doc.page <= 1} onClick={() => (doc.page = doc.page - 1)}>` - base.button takes disabled, pressed, onChange and children only; no onClick
`<base.button disabled={doc.pages === 0 || doc.page >= doc.pages} onClick={() => (doc.page = doc.page + 1)}>` - base.button takes no onClick
HV-4.notes: Camera side correct; Previous/Next are base.button with onClick, which base.button does not take, so they have no press handler under the sheet.

GN-2.tags: camera <View el={cam}>; pdf <View el={doc}>; import { camera, pdf, View } from '@markless/device'
mistakes: `<base.button onChange={async () => (photo = await cam.takePhoto())}>` - onChange is only called with the new state when `pressed` is given; a plain base.button has no state and no documented press callback
`<base.button onChange={() => cam.flip()}>` - same: onChange without `pressed` on a plain base.button
`<base.button disabled={doc.page <= 1} onChange={() => (doc.page = doc.page - 1)}>` - same: onChange without `pressed`
`<base.button disabled={doc.pages === 0 || doc.page >= doc.pages} onChange={() => (doc.page = doc.page + 1)}>` - same: onChange without `pressed`
GN-2.notes: Every button is base.button without pressed, using onChange as a click callback. The sheet ties onChange to the toggle form (pressed given); without pressed it is a plain button with no state, so no onChange press callback is documented. Shutter, flip and Previous/Next all rely on it.
